__

Whether in your backyard or in your living room, join families across the
country live on Facebook for a day of fun virtual adventures.

From camp-style cooking and friendly competitions, to special guests and
campfire singalongs, this virtual event will bring the best parts of Scouting
to life!

This National Camp-In is free and open to all families – including families
whose children are not currently in Scouting.

Schedule

## 10:00 a.m. CT

**Camp-In Kickoff, Campsite Construction, Live Conversation with Arctic Skiing
Adventurers**

Supply List: [Campsite Checklist](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2020/04/Campsite-Checklist.pdf)

[Coleman Campsite Giveaway Official Rules](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2020/05/Coleman-Campsite-Giveaway-Rules.pdf)

#CampIn #ScoutingAtHome

## 10:30 a.m. CT

**Virtual 5K Hike Benefitting Feeding America**

**Presenter:  ** Warmups led by Paralympic gold medalist David Blair

**Target Age:** All Ages

**Supply List:**  [Race bib](http://www.Scouting.org/GoodTurn5K) and safety
pins to fasten, activewear

**Resources:** [Scouting.org/GoodTurn5K](http://www.Scouting.org/GoodTurn5K)

 #GoodTurn5K

## 12:00 p.m. CT

**Cook with a MasterChef Junior Finalist**

**Presenter** : Life Scout Evan Robinson

**Target Age:** All Ages

**Recipes** : [Cheesy Pull-Aparts](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2020/04/Cheesy-Pull-Aparts.pdf), [Trio of Sauces
](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/Trio-of-Sauces.pdf)

 #CampInCooking

## 12:30 p.m. CT

**Moviemaking: behind-the-scenes set tour, storyboard workshop and live Q &A**

**Presenters:**  Live Q&A at 1 p.m. CT with Director/Producer Francis
Lawrence, Costume Supervisor Jessica Pazdernik, and Producer Shannon McIntosh.

**Target Age:** Geared toward Scouts BSA (ages 10-17)

**Supply List:** Drawing utensil, blank paper

## 2:00 p.m. CT

**NASA Astronaut**

**Presenter:  ** NASA Astronaut Doug Wheelock

**Target Age:** All Ages

**Supply List:  **Questions for Doug

## 2:30 p.m. CT

**Build a Flashlight from Household Items and Learn Knot Essentials**

Target Age: 9 and up for flashlight**  
**

**Supply List and Resources:**

  * [Flashlight Supply list ](https://boyslife.org/hobbies-projects/projects/165778/how-to-make-a-paper-tube-flashlight/)
  * At least two pieces of rope about 1 yard each. 3mm paracord is ideal. 

## 3:00 p.m. CT

**Steve Wozniak Talks STEM**

**Presenter:** Steve Wozniak

**Target Age:** The conversation is geared toward Scouts BSA youth (ages
10-17) and adults. Cub Scouts may want to try one or more of the STEM
activities, linked below.

**Resources:**[Cub Scout STEM
Activities](https://www.youtube.com/user/STEMScouts)

## 4:00 p.m. CT

**Fitness with Scout Ninja**

**Presenter:  **Jackson Meyer

**Target Age:** All Ages

**Supply List:** Activewear



## 5:00 p.m. CT

**Wilderness Survival Tips**

**Presenters:  ** Team Eagle from upcoming season of Eco-Challenge TV show

**Target Age:** Geared toward Scouts BSA (ages 10-17)



## 6:00 p.m. CT

Easy Camp-Style Dinner Favorites

Presenters: Chef Dean Fearing, Chef Jeff Philbin

Target Age: All Ages

## 6:30 p.m. CT

**Skillet S'mores**

Presenters: Life Scout Evan Robinson

Target Age: All Ages
